Container.Name: Rivune
Container.Overview:
Rivune is an open-source, self-hosted media frontend and backend. The application contains no predefined catalogue or media service: users connect their own addons and sources.
REQUIRED: A TLS-enabled PostgreSQL 18 server must already exist. Create separate custom Docker networks such as rivune-edge and rivune-database: connect Rivune to both, the HTTPS reverse proxy only to edge, and PostgreSQL only to database. Do not put the proxy and PostgreSQL on one network.
REQUIRED: Reach Rivune only through an HTTPS reverse proxy on the edge network. This template deliberately publishes no raw HTTP port. Set Public URL to the proxy's HTTPS origin and trust only the dedicated edge network.
REQUIRED: Generate a versioned encryption keyring and back it up separately from the database. A database backup containing encrypted provider credentials or profile tracking tokens cannot recover them without every matching key version.
Provider credentials and product/runtime choices are configured after setup in Rivune Administration, not in this template. Hardware acceleration is a persisted requested setting; after changing it, recreate or restart the container and wait for the active value to reconcile before treating it as enabled.
AMD/Intel GPU: this template maps /dev/dri/renderD128 and defaults to Unraid's usual video group GID 18. Verify the actual GID with: stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128. If it differs, set AMD/Intel render group ID to the reported value. Remove the device mapping on hosts without that render node. PostgreSQL must present a certificate signed by the mounted CA whose SAN exactly matches PostgreSQL host; sslmode=verify-full never falls back to plaintext.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 18 with TLS enabled, a CA certificate mounted read-only, separate edge and database Docker networks, and an HTTPS reverse proxy. For AMD/Intel hardware transcoding, /dev/dri/renderD128 must exist on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Required HTTPS origin served by the reverse proxy, for example https://rivune.example.com. Non-loopback HTTP is rejected.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL host
Config.Description: PostgreSQL hostname or IP on the database-only Docker network. The server certificate SAN must match this exact value.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL TCP port.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL database
Config.Description: Existing PostgreSQL database name.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL user
Config.Description: Dedicated non-superuser application role. Never use the bootstrap or restore login here.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password
Config.Description: Password for the dedicated non-superuser Rivune role.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL CA certificate
Config.Description: Public CA certificate that signs the PostgreSQL server certificate. Mount only ca.crt here, never the CA private key.

Config.Name: Initial setup token
Config.Description: One-time token used to claim a new instance. Generate a long independent random value.

Config.Name: Encryption keyring
Config.Description: Required active-first keyring. Format each entry as version:64-lowercase-hex, for example 1:<output of openssl rand -hex 32>. Back it up; encrypted database values are unrecoverable without matching versions.

Config.Name: Container user ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid's standard non-root nobody user ID. Rivune prepares writable host paths before dropping privileges.

Config.Name: Container group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid's standard users group ID.

Config.Name: Transcode directory
Config.Description: Host resource for temporary playback media. Prefer a cache-pool path with enough space for the quota selected in Administration.

Config.Name: Media workspace path
Config.Description: Fixed container path matching the Transcode directory mapping. This is host topology, not the media quota setting.

Config.Name: AMD/Intel render device
Config.Description: VAAPI or Intel Quick Sync render node. Remove this entry when no AMD/Intel GPU is available.

Config.Name: AMD/Intel render group ID
Config.Description: Numeric group owning the mapped render node. Verify with stat -c '%g' /dev/dri/renderD128 on the host.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL SSL mode
Config.Description: Required fail-closed TLS mode. Keep verify-full; do not use disable, allow, prefer, or require.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL CA path
Config.Description: Container path matching the read-only PostgreSQL CA certificate mount.

Config.Name: Trusted reverse proxies
Config.Description: Proxy IP or narrow CIDR allowed to supply forwarding headers. Trust only the dedicated edge network; never a LAN, database network, or 0.0.0.0/0.

Config.Name: NAT64 prefixes
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated RFC 6052 prefixes supplied by the trusted network operator.

Config.Name: LAN artwork origins
Config.Description: Optional exact private-IP origins for trusted LAN artwork hosts. Explicit ports are required; never enter DNS names, paths, queries, tokens, loopback, or link-local addresses.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Internal HTTP listener for the HTTPS reverse proxy. Do not publish this port on the Unraid host.
